# CLI reference

Every command, flag and exit code of `opencode-unity`, taken from the same table the argument parser and
`opencode-unity help` read. `opencode-unity help <command>` prints the same information at the terminal.

With `--json`, every command prints one JSON envelope on standard output and its human text on standard
error: `{ ok, command, exitCode, code, message, data, warnings, version }`, where `ok` is true exactly
when `exitCode` is 0 and `code` is a stable snake_case identifier.

## Commands

- Everyday: [`doctor`](#doctor), [`setup`](#setup), [`init`](#init), [`start`](#start)
- Advanced: [`status`](#status), [`guard`](#guard), [`warm`](#warm), [`stop`](#stop), [`bench`](#bench), [`delegate`](#delegate), [`upgrade`](#upgrade), [`uninstall`](#uninstall)

## Global options

Every command accepts these.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print a JSON envelope on stdout; human text goes to stderr |
| `--yes` | Accept the recommended consent answers in non-interactive runs |
| `--dry-run` | Print the plan and manifest entries; write nothing |
| `--project <dir>` | Unity project to act on |
| `--experimental` | Allow experimental platforms, versions and presets |
| `--verbose` | More output, including stack traces on errors |
| `--no-color` | Plain output without colors |
| `--help` | Show help |
| `--version` | Show the version |

## Exit codes

A released exit code never changes meaning.

| Exit | Name | Default `code` | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `OK` | `ok` | Success |
| 1 | `USAGE` | `usage_error` | Bad flags or config, not a Unity project, or missing facts |
| 2 | `BLOCKED` | `blocked` | GPU guard blocked, Ollama unreachable, or GPU busy |
| 3 | `BUDGET` | `budget_exceeded` | Context budget exceeded |
| 4 | `VALIDATION` | `validation_failed` | Effective-config verification, edit validation or review check failed |
| 5 | `CHECK_FAILED` | `check_failed` | Doctor errors, failed check command, bench below threshold, or failed self-test |
| 6 | `LOCK_TIMEOUT` | `lock_timeout` | GPU lock not acquired in time |
| 7 | `RUNTIME` | `runtime_error` | Unexpected error, or the OpenCode child exited non-zero |
| 8 | `UNSUPPORTED` | `unsupported` | Platform, version, preset or command not supported here |
| 9 | `CONSENT_REQUIRED` | `consent_required` | Non-interactive run needs --yes |
| 130 | `INTERRUPTED` | `interrupted` | Interrupted (Ctrl+C) |

## Support tiers

Before a command runs, the platform gate looks up this machine in `src/core/tiers.json`: the first
matching row wins. `refused` exits 8 before the command starts. `experimental` runs, on a row the
reference measurements do not cover; `setup` asks you to acknowledge it first, or takes
`--experimental` as the acknowledgement. `degraded` runs and names what it cannot measure.

| Platform | `doctor` | `setup` | `init` | `start` | `status` | `guard` | `warm` | `stop` | `bench` | `delegate` | `upgrade` | `uninstall` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| WSL or container | full (reports an ERROR) | refused | full | refused | refused | refused | refused | refused | refused | refused | full | full |
| Unsupported OS version | full | refused | full | refused | refused | refused | refused | refused | refused | refused | full | full |
| Windows 10/11 | full | full | full | full | full | full | full | full | full | full | full | full |
| Linux + amdgpu | full (experimental backend) | experimental | full | experimental | experimental | experimental | experimental | experimental | experimental | experimental | full | full |
| Linux + NVIDIA | full | experimental | full | experimental | experimental | experimental | experimental | experimental | experimental | experimental | full | full |
| Linux arm64 | degraded | refused | full | refused | refused | refused | refused | refused | refused | refused | full | full |
| macOS 14+, Apple silicon | degraded | experimental (degraded, no shipped preset) | full | experimental (degraded) | experimental (degraded) | experimental (degraded) | experimental (degraded) | experimental (degraded) | experimental (degraded) | experimental (degraded) | full | full |
| macOS Intel | degraded | refused | full | refused | refused | refused | refused | refused | refused | refused | full | full |
| Not in the support matrix | degraded | refused | full | refused | refused | refused | refused | refused | refused | refused | full | full |

What a refusal prints:

- `virtualized_host`: The Unity Editor runs outside this environment, so the GPU guard cannot see it. Run opencode-unity on the host instead.
- `os_version`: Ollama does not support this OS version.
- `linux_arm64`: The Unity Editor is not available for Linux on arm64, so there is no project for this command to act on. doctor and init still run.
- `darwin_intel`: Ollama runs on CPU only on Intel Macs, so a 30B model is not usable for agent work. doctor and init still run.
- `unsupported_platform`: This platform is not a row in the support matrix, so the GPU guard has never been run on it. doctor and init still run.

## doctor

```text
opencode-unity doctor [path] [options]
```

Diagnose an OpenCode + Ollama setup without loading a model. Static analysis by default. Only --deep, --capture and --selftest start OpenCode, and they say so first.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `[path]` | Project directory (default: --project or the current directory) |

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--profile` | Analyze the opencode-unity clean-room profile for this project |
| `--deep` | Also run opencode debug config and debug agent |
| `--capture` | Record the exact first request against a local mock endpoint (not available in this build; exits 8) |
| `--selftest` | Run mock end-to-end scenarios with the installed OpenCode (not available in this build; exits 8) |
| `--logs <path>` | Ollama server log to read |
| `--markdown` | Issue-ready report (implies --redact) |
| `--redact` | Remove user, machine, path, project, email and key values |
| `--strict` | Warnings also fail |
| `--explain <check-id>` | Print one check's rationale and fix |

Exit codes: 0 (OK), 1 (USAGE), 5 (CHECK_FAILED), 7 (RUNTIME), 8 (UNSUPPORTED).

## setup

```text
opencode-unity setup [options]
```

Install the clean-room profile and the local model, asking before each change.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--preset <id>` | Model preset (default: recommended from detected VRAM) |
| `--no-model` | Skip the model pull and create |
| `--ollama-env` | Preselect the Ollama server environment item |
| `--terminal` | Preselect the Windows Terminal fragment |
| `--host <ids>` | Name the host integration for these tools; the host command group is planned, so this preview prints how to copy the preview host files (comma-separated: claude, codex, antigravity, auto) |
| `--delegate <targets>` | Deprecated alias of --host (comma-separated: claude, codex) |
| `--migrate` | Migrate an earlier installation (used by upgrade) |

Exit codes: 0 (OK), 1 (USAGE), 2 (BLOCKED), 4 (VALIDATION), 7 (RUNTIME), 8 (UNSUPPORTED), 9 (CONSENT_REQUIRED).

## init

```text
opencode-unity init [path] [options]
```

Scan a Unity project (read-only) and write its facts.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `[path]` | Project directory (default: --project or the current directory) |

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--editor` | Enable the editor-check agent (needs MCP for Unity) |
| `--in-project` | Write the facts into the project under .opencode-unity/ |
| `--refresh` | Scan again |
| `--print` | Print the facts only |

Exit codes: 0 (OK), 1 (USAGE), 7 (RUNTIME), 9 (CONSENT_REQUIRED).

## start

```text
opencode-unity start [path] [options]
```

Launch OpenCode for a Unity project in the clean room.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `[path]` | Project directory (default: --project or the current directory) |

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--agent <unity-code\|unity-editor>` | Agent to open |
| `--warm` | Guarded warm-up before launch |
| `--no-pane` | No Windows Terminal status pane |
| `--no-project-config` | Ignore project opencode.json and .opencode folders |
| `--print-env` | Print the launch environment and content; do not launch |
| `--continue` | Forwarded to OpenCode |
| `--session <id>` | Forwarded to OpenCode |
| `--prompt <text>` | Forwarded to OpenCode |

Refused flags (exit 1): `--auto`, `--yolo`, `--dangerously-skip-permissions`. Start refuses auto-approval flags: dangerous actions are denied and every remaining ask must reach you.

Exit codes: 0 (OK), 1 (USAGE), 2 (BLOCKED), 4 (VALIDATION), 7 (RUNTIME), 8 (UNSUPPORTED).


| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--watch` | Refresh continuously |
| `--interval <seconds>` | Refresh interval (default 10) (range 1 to 3600) |

Exit codes: 0 (OK), 2 (BLOCKED), 7 (RUNTIME).

## guard

```text
opencode-unity guard [options]
```

Evaluate the GPU guard without loading a model.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--cold` | Ignore the loaded state |

Exit codes: 0 (OK), 2 (BLOCKED).

## warm

```text
opencode-unity warm [options]
```

Load the model after the guard passes.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--keep-alive <duration>` | How long Ollama keeps the model loaded |

Exit codes: 0 (OK), 2 (BLOCKED), 6 (LOCK_TIMEOUT), 7 (RUNTIME).

## stop

```text
opencode-unity stop [options]
```

Unload the model to free VRAM.

Exit codes: 0 (OK), 2 (BLOCKED), 7 (RUNTIME).

## bench

```text
opencode-unity bench <suite> [options]
```

Run guarded reliability benchmarks on the bundled sample project.

**Not available in this build.** Running it exits 8 with the code `command_not_available`.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `<suite>` | Benchmark suite: toolcalls, edits, editor, guard, budget, all |

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--runs <n>` | Runs per task (default 20) (range 1 to 1000) |
| `--temperature <t>` | Sampling temperature override (range 0 to 2) |

Exit codes: 0 (OK), 2 (BLOCKED), 5 (CHECK_FAILED), 7 (RUNTIME).

## delegate

```text
opencode-unity delegate <subcommand> [options]
```

Hand bulk, low-ambiguity work to the guarded local model (Claude Code, Codex).

### delegate health

```text
opencode-unity delegate health [options]
```

Check Ollama, the model tag, the guard verdict and the lock holder.

### delegate ask

```text
opencode-unity delegate ask [options]
```

One request over the task and the named files.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--task <text\|@file>` | Task text, or @file to read it from a file (required) |
| `--files <paths...>` | Files passed as untrusted data (takes every value up to the next flag) |
| `--max-output <n>` | Maximum output tokens (range 1 to 1000000) |
| `--allow-sensitive` | Allow files that match sensitive patterns |

### delegate map

```text
opencode-unity delegate map [options]
```

One request per file, then an optional reduce request.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--task <text\|@file>` | Task text, or @file to read it from a file (required) |
| `--files <paths\|globs...>` | Files or globs to map over (required; takes every value up to the next flag) |
| `--reduce <instruction>` | Instruction for the reduce request |

### delegate edit

```text
opencode-unity delegate edit [options]
```

Dry run: validated SEARCH/REPLACE blocks and a review id.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--task <text\|@file>` | Task text, or @file to read it from a file (required) |
| `--files <paths...>` | Files the edit may touch (required; takes every value up to the next flag) |
| `--check <auto\|command>` | Check command to run after apply |

### delegate apply

```text
opencode-unity delegate apply <reviewId> [options]
```

Apply exactly the reviewed blocks, then run the check.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `<reviewId>` | Review id printed by edit |

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--check <auto\|command>` | Check command to run after apply |

### delegate restore

```text
opencode-unity delegate restore <jobId> [options]
```

Restore the backups of a job.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `<jobId>` | Job id |

### delegate ledger

```text
opencode-unity delegate ledger [options]
```

Job counts, tokens, durations and estimated paid tokens avoided.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--since <duration>` | Only jobs newer than this, for example 7d |

Exit codes: 0 (OK), 1 (USAGE), 2 (BLOCKED), 3 (BUDGET), 4 (VALIDATION), 5 (CHECK_FAILED), 6 (LOCK_TIMEOUT), 7 (RUNTIME), 8 (UNSUPPORTED).

## upgrade

```text
opencode-unity upgrade [options]
```

Migrate the config and profile after a package update.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--rollback` | Switch back to the previous profile |
| `--prune-models` | Remove model tags of older presets |

Exit codes: 0 (OK), 4 (VALIDATION), 7 (RUNTIME), 9 (CONSENT_REQUIRED).

## uninstall

```text
opencode-unity uninstall [options]
```

Remove what setup installed, from the install manifest.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--keep-data` | Keep state and project facts |
| `--remove-models` | Remove created model tags |
| `--remove-base-model` | Also remove the base model if setup pulled it |
| `--projects` | Also remove unchanged in-project folders |

Exit codes: 0 (OK), 4 (VALIDATION), 7 (RUNTIME), 9 (CONSENT_REQUIRED).
